gen.title: Acidity scale basics for classroom review

cards.stem: Which value on the pH scale shows neutral water?
cards.quote: The range goes from 0 to 14, with 7 being neutral.
cards.hint: Think about the middle of the scale.

cards.stem: What must a solution contain to have a pH value?
cards.quote: for a solution to have a pH, it has to be aqueous (contains water).
cards.hint: Recall what type of liquid allows pH.

cards.stem: What does pH measure in water?
cards.quote: pH is a measure of how acidic/basic water is.

cards.stem: Which pH values show that water is acidic?
cards.quote: pHs of less than 7 indicate acidity, whereas a pH of greater than 7 indicates a base.
